product_overview: Jhome is an enterprise platform with a public-facing site and an authenticated admin dashboard. It supports administrator login, dashboard management, academy operations, user management, media handling, and live course-room interactions.
core_goals: Log in as an administrator to access the admin dashboard
View and manage platform content and operational data from the dashboard
Create and maintain academy users and course-related records
Join and participate in live course video sessions
Log out of the authenticated session

features.name: Administrator Login
features.description: Allows administrators to authenticate with email and password and enter the protected admin area.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Switch to Admin Tab -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit login form -> See the admin dashboard
Navigate to / -> Switch to Admin Tab -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit login form with invalid credentials -> See an error message

features.name: Student Login
features.description: Allows students to authenticate using a generic login code and room ID to enter the academy experience.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Fill in login code -> Fill in room ID -> Submit login form -> See the course room
Navigate to / -> Fill in login code -> Fill in room ID -> Submit login form with invalid credentials -> See an error message

features.name: Admin Dashboard
features.description: Provides authenticated administrators with a central place to view dashboard content and access platform management areas.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin-panel.html -> View dashboard statistics -> Open widgets -> Use quick actions
Navigate to /admin-panel.html -> Navigate through the available admin menu sections -> Open each page

features.name: Academy User Management
features.description: Lets administrators create and manage academy users such as students and related roles.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin-panel.html -> Fill in the new student form -> Submit the form -> See the generated username and password
Navigate to /admin-panel.html -> Manage courses and roles -> Update the selected user role -> See the updated user information

features.name: Course Video Room
features.description: Enables authenticated users to join live academy sessions and interact through audio, screen sharing, and chat.
user_flows: Navigate to /course-room.html -> Join the meeting -> See the live video room -> Send a chat message -> Mute the microphone -> Unmute the microphone -> Share the screen

user_interactions: See error message on invalid credentials

user_interactions: See error message on invalid credentials
